visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a crowded indoor public space, likely a railway station or terminal, with a vaulted ceiling and a prominent support pillar. In the foreground, a man in a top hat and a woman in a long dress and cape are standing together, engaged in conversation with another man wearing a bowler hat. The background is filled with a dense crowd of people, many wearing hats, suggesting a busy transit environment.
